channel.description: Curated tech opinions and blog posts

item.title: Zvi Mowshowitz: Leaked Anthropic Draft AI Regulatory Bill Is Unacceptable and Troubling
item.description: Anthropic is shopping a federal bill that preempts stronger state laws like SB 53 while weakening enforcement and auditor licensing — weaker, Zvi argues, than Anthropic's own June framework.

item.title: Nathan Lambert: Meta shakes up the frontiers, open and closed
item.description: Muse Spark Open halves the US-China open-weight gap and makes Meta the only American lab with frontier open and closed models — but its custom license is an unnecessary strategic risk.

item.title: Francesco Maggi (via Terry Tao): Will it be a golden age or a dark age for mathematics (and science)?
item.description: Golden age if LLMs empower a new generation and stay open; dark age if output soars while human understanding withers and concentrates in a few hands — society will need a lot more mathematicians, not fewer.
